facts.activity_file: proving dead and testing for zero energy

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM service bulletin affecting SLP-CLASS-B

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 31 December 2008 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
